flags.message: In record/documents/petition.txt (106 pages, empty_text=false, ocr_derived=false), the front matter (cover, Questions Presented, Table of Contents, Table of Authorities, pp. i-xi) and the entire Appendix (pp. 1a-63a) extracted cleanly, but pages 1-29 of the Petition body extracted as ~45 blank lines (lines 286-331) with no pipeline truncation note, suggesting mixed PDF text/image layers where overall text volume masked empty body pages from OCR fallback.

record/documents/lower-court-docket.txt reports 'petition filed: none' and 'disposition: not found' for rehearing en banc because the 4 post-judgment RECAP docket entries on CourtListener (docket 68399001, entries 64, 65, 73, 76 between 2026-07-15 and 2026-08-11) have blank description strings; Petition Appendix A (petition.txt, pp. 1a-2a) shows that Petitioners did petition for rehearing en banc and the Fourth Circuit denied it on 2026-08-11 with no judge requesting a poll.
